title: On This Hill Whatever You FORGET Comes Back Up
description:
On this hill, whatever you forget comes back up out of the ground. Leave your keys in the lettuce and by Thursday there's a key plant. Nothing has ever come up in my plot, because I don't forget things.

Grandad has the plot across the path. This week his glasses came up in his beans. Then on Monday something much bigger came up by the gate, and every dawn it's one plot nearer to his.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: What would come up in your plot by Thursday?
